verdict.rationale: React is a client-side UI library with no HTTP API, so an OpenAPI document does not fit it, and the OpenAPI probe found 404s at every candidate path. The closest machine-readable equivalent is the TypeScript type definitions (@types/react, @types/react-dom), which describe React's API surface. The llms.txt index and .md reference pages give agent-readable but unstructured docs. Missing for 10: an official, versioned, structured API spec artifact (e.g. a published JSON schema or API-extractor report) and evidence that agents consume the type definitions as a spec.
